name: Telluride Blues & Brews Festival
_dataNote: Content sourced from tellurideblues.com (official site) on 2026-09-01, transcribed via a research dossier. SET TIMES MUST BE RE-VERIFIED AGAINST THE OFFICIAL SCHEDULE BEFORE LAUNCH. Known caveats: (1) announcements.json is ILLUSTRATIVE — those five entries were written for this build and are the only category not taken from the site, though each is derived from a real 2026 fact; (2) late-night show end times are not published by the festival — every Juke Joint, Bal De Maison and Fais Do-Do set carries a placeholder 90-minute end time, flagged in its note; (3) brewery city/state is NOT published on the official site — every location in breweries.json is inferred and unverified; (4) beers.json contains only the two beers the site actually names (Sierra Nevada Pale Ale and Hazy Little Thing IPA); their ABV figures are general knowledge, not from the site; (5) vendors.json is empty because no food or craft vendor names are published; (6) no official grounds map exists — places.json x/y coordinates are a reconstruction from confirmed prose relationships (entrance north, Beer Garden between Main and Blues stages, Kids Area northeast, campground east, Medical Tent east edge) and the Truck Stage position is unknown; (7) the venue lat/lng is inferred from the 500 E Colorado Avenue address and has not been surveyed; (8) artist genre tags are an editorial categorisation, not festival-published genres; (9) five non-performer entries in artists.json (brewers-showcase, blisters-brews-5k, yoga-sessions, blues-for-breakfast, blues-challenge-winner-2026) exist only so every published schedule slot has a resolvable artist reference.
